description: This Swift source file defines the PresenceReporter class which manages periodic and immediate presence reporting for a macOS application. It handles starting and stopping presence updates, constructs presence data, and sends system events to a control channel.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing and sending system presence information on macOS.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic task that reports presence at regular intervals.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic presence reporting task.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Constructs and sends a presence update with the specified reason.

methods.name: sendImmediate
methods.description: Immediately triggers a presence update with a default reason 'connect'.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string describing current presence status.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Provides a string representing the current macOS platform version.
